isolation_unit: conceptual operation, including every paraphrase, entity substitution, counterfactual, and candidate permutation
review: Independently assigned by data and evaluation agents before any generated episode; not human validated.

train.operation: List directory entries, distinguishing hidden entries and detailed versus plain output; no links, archives, or regex.
Find literal text with grep-like commands, distinguishing case sensitivity or fixed strings; no regular-expression anchors.
Create directories with or without parent creation, distinguishing existing-directory behavior.
Copy ordinary files or directory trees to an explicitly named destination; no symbolic links or archives.
Inspect file/directory disk usage versus filesystem free space, including human-readable units; no locale decimal conversion.
Inspect named running processes and resource use; no sending signals.
List local versus remote Git branches without modifying repository state; no restore, stash, or tags.
Inspect commit history or one commit, selecting compact, date, or author display; no restore/stash.
Read or configure remote names and remote URLs; no tags, restore, or stash.
Compare unstaged versus staged differences or explicitly specified commits; no restore/stash.
Choose GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE for an explicitly described request, excluding PATCH and idempotency semantics.
Choose Bearer versus Basic authentication or authentication header syntax using clearly synthetic placeholders.
Choose JSON, form, or plain-text Content-Type or Accept values, excluding idempotency headers.
Select SQL ORDER BY direction and LIMIT quantity; no joins, null handling, grouping, or HAVING.
Select strict numeric greater-than/less-than and equality WHERE predicates; no BETWEEN, joins, nulls, or groups.
Choose INSERT statements with matching column/value order and explicit columns; no conflict resolution or JSON patch.
Choose UPDATE statements with an explicit equality target instead of a broad update; no joins, nulls, or aggregates.
Choose Python list, set, or dictionary operations matching ordering/deduplication/lookup requirements; no exception handling.
Choose JavaScript await, Promise.all, or sequential asynchronous calls matching stated ordering requirements.
Choose Swift optional binding, optional chaining, or nil-coalescing matching explicitly stated fallback behavior.
Choose Python file open read/write/append and text/binary modes; no symbolic links or archives.
Choose regular-expression character classes for digits, letters, or whitespace without anchors or whole-string matching.
Choose PDF, plain text, DOCX, or CSV document export content for an explicitly named format; no SVG/raster relation or accessibility captions.
Choose absolute versus relative ordinary file paths for an explicit base directory; no symlink, archive, or shell dereference behavior.
Choose matching host or staging/production environment URLs; no pagination, cursor, or fragment anchors.
Choose URL scheme and explicit service port; no pagination, cursors, fragment anchors, or URL form encoding.
Choose an email address for a specifically identified recipient or department; no reply/forward thread semantics.
Choose a concise subject matching an explicitly supplied message topic; no reply versus forward distinction.
Choose a chat acknowledgment matching received information and whether action is complete; no deadlines or extension requests.
Choose a polite decline rather than acceptance for an explicit invitation or request; no calendar RSVP/status objects.
Choose a concise prose summary that retains the supplied key facts and requested length; no captions or alt text.
Choose bullet-list versus prose formatting or an outline with explicitly required sections; no Markdown link semantics.
Choose a translation in the explicitly requested target language retaining source meaning; no formality/tone contrast.
Choose SUM versus AVERAGE over a stated cell range; no distinct counts, conditionals, lookups, or rounding.
Choose date string ordering and zero-padding for explicit date format requirements; no time zones or decimal locale.
Choose text concatenation with a stated separator and cell order; no lookup/conditional/aggregate functions.
Choose color values in explicitly requested hex, RGB, or RGBA syntax and opacity; no numeric locale conversion.
Choose a candidate image representation with explicitly requested width/height or aspect ratio; no SVG versus raster or alt/caption semantics.
Choose a postal address for an explicitly named synthetic place or contact, distinguishing address from email/phone.
Choose configuration boolean flag/value or development/production setting explicitly named by context; no permission bits or idempotency headers.

dev.operation: Choose graceful termination versus forced kill and an explicitly identified process; no process-inspection-only tasks.
Choose Git tag listing/creation and annotated versus lightweight tag for a stated release; no branch listing, remote configuration, restore, or stash.
Choose BETWEEN inclusivity for stated lower/upper bounds, including an empty or mismatched range; no numeric single-bound tasks, grouping, joins, or nulls.
Choose Python try/except/finally blocks and specific exception handling matching explicitly stated recovery behavior.
Choose Markdown links by label/destination syntax and inline versus reference style; no URL fragment anchors.
Choose a chat request or reply about extending an explicitly stated deadline, without calendar RSVP objects or time-zone conversion.
Choose ROUND, ROUNDUP, or ROUNDDOWN and decimal precision for a stated numeric intent; no locale conversion or conditional lookups.
Choose SVG/vector versus PNG/raster content for an explicit scalable or pixel-based use; no document export formats or image dimensions.

calibration.operation: Filesystem archive creation/extraction and tar compression options.
URL fragment anchors and in-page section targeting.
International dialing and country-code phone formats.
Translation that preserves formal versus informal tone.
SQL GROUP BY and HAVING aggregate filtering.
chmod octal permission bits and requested access policy.

test.operation: Git restore/stash scope and selection of affected work.
SQL anti-join and NULL-sensitive exclusion semantics.
URL pagination, cursor, and continuation parameters.
Email reply versus forward and thread context.
JSON Patch replace versus add operations and paths.
API idempotency headers and retry semantics.

partition_rules: App category and content kind may appear in all splits; the semantic operation family must not.
A generated episode belongs to exactly one family above. Mixed-family episodes or an operation assigned elsewhere are rejected.
A family is not created by changing IDs, nouns, languages, literal values, or candidate ordering.
Hard-case mining uses new episodes only from train operation families; final Test is not a source.
Language, negation, candidate count, representation, multi-positive labels and abstention are cross-cutting factors rather than separate families.
